name: jawbot
description: Job-based Linux runtime with swappable channels (UI now, messaging later)

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @jawbot/server & npm run dev -w @jawbot/ui
scripts.build: npm run build -w @jawbot/shared && npm run build -w @jawbot/server && npm run build -w @jawbot/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @jawbot/shared && npm run typecheck -w @jawbot/server && npm run typecheck -w @jawbot/ui
